quarterly_data.quarter: Kurita Water Industries annual securities report: FY2026 (06-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 (year ended March 31, 2026; continuing operations, with Pentagon Technologies Group, Inc. classified as discontinued operations): orders received JPY 442,961 million (+7.3% YoY), net sales JPY 402,889 million (+3.6%), business profit JPY 57,343 million (+12.7%; business profit margin 14.2%), operating profit JPY 58,290 million (+16.8%). Profit attributable to owners of parent (continuing and discontinued operations combined) fell 21.4% to JPY 15,957 million because impairment losses on Pentagon's fixed assets including goodwill rose by JPY 3,418 million.
quarterly_data.figure: orders JPY 442,961 million (+7.3%); net sales JPY 402,889 million (+3.6%); business profit JPY 57,343 million (+12.7%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Kurita Water Industries annual securities report: FY2026 (06-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Electronics Industry segment FY2026 (continuing operations): orders JPY 208,970 million (+7.5%). Water treatment facilities orders topped the high prior-year level on several large projects won as investment to expand semiconductor fabs became active worldwide; maintenance orders rose on strong customer plant operation, mainly in Japan and South Korea. Net sales JPY 171,797 million (+1.4%): facilities sales fell on the reaction to several large projects booked in China in the prior year, while maintenance was strong. Business profit JPY 27,657 million (+5.6%) and operating profit JPY 28,712 million (+3.2%), on higher maintenance sales and improved facilities profitability. Other income included a JPY 785 million settlement gain on the cancellation of ultrapure water supply contracts with some customers (Electronics Industry).
quarterly_data.figure: Electronics orders JPY 208,970 million (+7.5%); net sales JPY 171,797 million (+1.4%); business profit JPY 27,657 million (+5.6%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Kurita Water Industries annual securities report: FY2026 (06-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: General Water Treatment segment FY2026: orders JPY 233,991 million (+7.1%), net sales JPY 231,091 million (+5.4%), business profit JPY 29,700 million (+20.1%), operating profit JPY 29,592 million (+34.0%). Facilities orders rose in the US and Singapore; water treatment chemicals orders grew on CSV business expansion despite weak markets in China and Southeast Asia; soil remediation orders rose sharply on a large project; facilities sales rose mainly on construction progress of large domestic projects, and water treatment chemicals, maintenance and recurring contract-based services sales also rose; the cost ratio improved on growth of the higher value-added CSV business.
quarterly_data.figure: orders JPY 233,991 million (+7.1%); net sales JPY 231,091 million (+5.4%); business profit JPY 29,700 million (+20.1%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Kurita Water Industries annual securities report: FY2026 (06-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management states that in the fiscal year ending March 2027 (FY2027), the fourth year of PSV-27, the Electronics Industry segment will keep winning water treatment facility projects through its global base and expand service business from them, and to meet customers' strong capex demand will raise production capacity by introducing design automation, using prefabrication methods such as its ready-made ultrapure water production system 'e-WT', and using external resources including M&A and collaboration. Over the plan's first three years it worked to build business bases in Europe, the US and Taiwan, which led to large water treatment facility project wins globally.

quarterly_data.quarter: Kurita Water Industries annual securities report: FY2026 (06-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 R&D expenses JPY 8,111 million (2.0% of net sales), about 224 R&D staff; Electronics Industry R&D JPY 3,854 million. Electronics results: a technology to recover and reuse spent etching chemicals containing fluorine and ammonium as a higher-value resource; ultrapure water production systems that follow swings in supply volume while keeping water quality, cutting operating energy; and, developed with a leading-edge semiconductor research institution, a cleaning technology using functional water that cleans the wafer surface while suppressing dissolution of copper and other wiring materials in the planarization step after wiring formation, for high-performance devices for AI and data centers.
quarterly_data.figure: R&D JPY 8,111 million; Electronics R&D JPY 3,854 million
